 KRK's Deshdrohi 2 coming soon! Pooja Hegde, Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Deepak Dobriyal onboard? Know the truth
 KRK has announced Deshdrohi 2 with a poster featuring Pooja Hegde, Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Deepak Dobriyal. However, Deepak has denied being part of the sequel.
 Nitesh Kumar Sahoo 
 18 Nov 2026 19:05 IST
 Pooja Hegde and Nawazuddin Siddiqui in KRK Deshdrohi Photograph: (Instagram/Pooja Hegde, Nawazuddin Siddiqui)
 Social media announcements by celebrities often trigger speculation about upcoming film projects. However, not every promotional poster tells the complete story. Kamaal R Khan, popularly known as KRK , has now sparked curiosity by announcing a sequel to his much-memed film, Deshdrohi.
 Advertisment Also Check: Here’s what Sunny Leone thinks about Urfi Javed; KRK takes a stand for Uorfi 
 Pooja Hegde, Nawazuddin And Deepak Dobriyal On The Poster 
 On Wednesday, KRK took to Instagram to announce Deshdrohi 2. The poster caught attention for featuring photographs of Pooja Hegde, Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Deepak Dobriyal. Their presence immediately raised questions about whether the three actors had joined the project.
 Advertisment However, KRK offered no clarification about their involvement. His caption simply read, “Get ready. Deshdrohi2 is coming soon.”
 View this post on Instagram 
 He neither mentioned the actors in his announcement nor tagged their social media accounts.
 Deepak Dobriyal Dismisses The Casting Buzz 
 The announcement soon faced questions when HT City contacted Deepak Dobriyal for confirmation. The actor dismissed the reports and clarified that he had no knowledge of being associated with the sequel.
 “It's not true. Atleast 15 people I know have sent me the same (post).”
 His response has cast doubt on the casting claims, leaving the actual lineup of Deshdrohi 2 uncertain.
 Not KRK's First Announcement About The Sequel 
 Interestingly, this is not the first time KRK has spoken about bringing back Deshdrohi. In 2022, he had shared another poster on social media and announced, “Shooting is going to start soon!”
 However, that announcement did not translate into any widely confirmed production update.
 From Deshdrohi's Viral Memes To Trolling Over His Film Reviews 
 KRK continues to remain a controversial figure in the entertainment industry. His frequent remarks targeting several prominent Indian film personalities, particularly Salman Khan, have repeatedly invited criticism and trolling. His film reviews, too, often leave social media users questioning their logic and credibility.
 Before becoming a controversial self-proclaimed film critic, KRK had tried his luck in acting. He made his debut as a lead actor with the 2008 release Deshdrohi. Although the film failed to make a mark at the box office, it later gained attention across social media through memes and viral clips.
 Must Check: KRK issues warning to Salman Khan; vows to make him 'suffer like pig' 
 Interestingly, KRK himself became meme material after Deshdrohi. His unusual dialogues, action sequences and dance steps have turned into viral content, with social media users continuing to share and poke fun at those scenes even years after the film's release.
 He also appeared in Mohit Suri's 2014 thriller Ek Villain, featuring Sidharth Malhotra and Shraddha Kapoor.
